name: daily-image-compliance-check
description: Daily product image quality and accessibility audit — alt-text, dimensions, and CDN cache health.
prompt: Scan all products activated in last 24h for image compliance: verify primary image is present, dimensions >= 800x800, file size < 150KB WebP, alt-text is present and descriptive. Check CDN cache hit rate. Report any non-compliant listings and block activation if primary image missing.
